title: Ashbury Rewards Co-brand Cardmember Benefit: Breakfast Uplift on Guest Folios
content:
Cardmembers of the Ashbury Rewards co-brand credit cards receive a breakfast uplift on the elite breakfast credit posted to their Guest Folios.

**Term.** Co-brand breakfast uplift: a membership linked to the Ashbury Rewards Premier Card adds the premier card uplift of $5.00 to each covered person's credit, a membership linked to the Ashbury Rewards Card adds the rewards card uplift of $2.00, and a membership with no linked card adds nothing. The uplift is added to each covered person's credit before that credit is taken for the persons covered.

The linked card is the co-brand card shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay, as reported by the issuing bank.

## Uplift by linked card

| Co-brand card linked to the Ashbury Rewards membership | Uplift per covered person |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Premier Card | $5.00 |
| Ashbury Rewards Card | $2.00 |
| No linked card | None |

## Cardmember questions

**A member holds the Ashbury Rewards Card. What does the card add at breakfast?** $2.00 to each covered person's credit; with two persons covered, $4.00 on the morning.

**A member holds the Ashbury Rewards Premier Card and three persons are covered.** $5.00 for each of the three, $15.00 on the morning.

**A member has no co-brand card linked.** The card adds nothing.
